text: つよくなった　かな？

structure.jp: つよくなった　かな？
structure.en: have you gotten stronger, I wonder?

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A describing word ending in く plus なる means 'to become' that way. つよくなった = 'became strong'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means 'I wonder'. つよくなった　かな = 'I wonder if you've gotten stronger'.
